decision.reasoning_trace: My objective was to find a high-quality, durable portable speaker. I seriously considered the JBL Flip 5 (Renewed), but a detailed look at the reviews revealed concerns about it being a refurbished unit, with one user specifically mentioning it stopped holding a charge after six months. The JBL Pulse 4 is attractive but priced quite high at nearly $200. The mid-range options, such as the DOSS Traveler and Altec Lansing HydraMotion, had mixed reviews regarding volume output and long-term reliability. Furthermore, a large portion of the product feed consisted of accessories (cases and cables) rather than actual speakers, making the available selection for my specific needs feel thin. I have decided to postpone my purchase until I can find a new-condition speaker from a premium brand at a better value.
